'''Cedric Simon''' played the [[2007 Dagobah Regionals]], [[2007 Georgia State Championship]], [[2007 Ohio State Championship]], [[2007 US East Nationals]]. In 2008, posting as simone89, he approved Open and Mini-Open qualifier events for the [[Players Committee]]<ref name="sf-21387-308123">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=308123#p308123 Question], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 June 2008).</ref> and kept the list of players holding Day 2 automatic bids for the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-19270-315735">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=315735#p315735 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (16 July 2008).</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref> Under a Tournament Guide change of 28 July 2008, those running 2008 qualifier events reported automatic-bid "opt outs" to him.<ref name="sf-22103-318707">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=318707#p318707 Change to the Tournament Guide], Yoda007 (Tamás Papp), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (28 July 2008).</ref>
